message: Astra: Within Fa na’s investigation, does your proposal that “Alexander submits audit requests and analyzes the data” give each character distinct work in the actual scene, or only in your explanation? Which passage would discriminate? What would further thinking clarify that an informative drafting attempt would not, and what uncertainty could justify postponing that attempt? Could you briefly identify in English what is written, what remains uncertain, and which next step you choose, then carry it out?
